summary: Render a deterministic private stack deployment
description: Render a machine-specific Compose/config/secret-reference bundle outside Git from validated desired state and preflight evidence.
acceptance: Equivalent desired state and preflight inputs produce a byte-stable deployment identity and deterministic private bundle under the configured XDG runtime root.
Rendered Compose uses immutable images, health checks, bounded resources, explicit networks, least privilege, no Docker socket, and validated storage mappings.
Credential values never enter plans, logs, Git fixtures, command arguments, or rendered public evidence; only protected runtime files and secret references are used.
Rendering refuses stale preflight evidence, unsafe path changes, unsupported exposure, and missing backup or rollback prerequisites.
